Larger Bus with Sophisticated Imaging Instruments. Lots of Autonomy / On-Board Data Processing. Climate Change Research Objectives.
Description

After LORIS' success in 2022, Dalhousie University's Space Systems Lab, in partnership with GALAXIA Mission Systems and support of the Canadian Space Agency is thrilled to announce MANTIS!

  • Larger Bus with Sophisticated Imaging Instruments
  • Lots of Autonomy / On-Board Data Processing
  • Climate Change Research Objectives
  • Brand-new Cutting-Edge Space Tech
Notes

One of 9 winners of the 2023 CUBICS Canadian CubeSat Project.
